title: Inference and Uncertainty Quantification for Streaming $r$-PCA
abstract: arXiv:2608.18374v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We address two open questions in streaming PCA via Oja's algorithm: sharp operator-norm convergence for general rank under sub-Gaussian data, and distributional inference for the resulting subspace estimator. Existing convergence analyses, even in the rank-one case, either assume bounded data or leave non-vanishing remainder terms that prevent adaptation to a polynomially vanishing tail spectrum, while existing distributional results are confined to the rank-one case. Our convergence theory removes these remainder terms and yields a sharp rate. In the dense-tail spiked covariance regime, this rate matches the minimax rate up to logarithmic factors. More generally, we prove a matching lower bound, up to logarithmic factors, across both dense-tail and sparse-tail regimes under a mild nondegeneracy condition. The analysis yields a linearization of Oja's iterates, which in turn enables a high-dimensional Gaussian approximation for the gene

translated_title: 流式$r$-PCA的推断与不确定性量化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18374v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们通过Oja算法解决了流式PCA中的两个开放问题：在次高斯数据下一般秩的尖锐算子范数收敛，以及由此产生的子空间估计量的分布推断。现有的收敛性分析，即使在秩为一的情况下，要么假设数据有界，要么留下不消失的余项，从而阻碍了对多项式衰减尾部谱的适应性，而现有的分布结果仅限于秩为一的情况。我们的收敛理论去除了这些余项，并得到了一个尖锐的速率。在密集尾部尖峰协方差体制下，该速率在对数因子内达到极小极大速率。更一般地，我们在温和的非退化条件下，证明了在密集尾部和稀疏尾部体制下，匹配的下界在对数因子内成立。该分析导出了Oja迭代的线性化，进而实现了对基因的高维高斯近似。
tldr: 本文通过Oja算法解决了流式PCA的尖锐收敛速率和分布推断问题，首次在一般秩下实现无余项的收敛分析，并建立匹配的极小极大下界。
en_tdlr: This paper resolves sharp convergence rates and distributional inference for streaming PCA via Oja's algorithm, achieving remainder-free analysis for general rank and establishing matching minimax lower bounds.
